documents.title: Acme Master Services Agreement 2024
documents.text:
# Acme Master Services Agreement 2024

## Section 1: Term

This Agreement begins on January 1, 2024 and continues for twelve months unless terminated earlier.

## Section 4: Limitation of Liability

Section 4.2 does not apply in the case of gross negligence or willful misconduct by either party.

## Section 7: Termination

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience with 30 days written notice. Early cancellation before the term ends requires a pro-rated refund of prepaid fees.

## Section 9: Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

documents.title: Acme Data Processing Agreement
documents.text:
# Acme Data Processing Agreement (DPA)

## Section 2: Security Obligations

The Processor shall maintain SOC 2 Type II certification and provide evidence upon request.

## Section 5: Data Breach Notification

In the event of a data breach, the Processor shall notify the Controller within 72 hours. The Controller's security team is responsible for coordinating the incident response.

## Remote Work Policy

Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Full-time remote arrangements require VP sign-off.

## Expense Reimbursement
